tokenName: Electricity Company of Ghana Commodity-Backed Warehouse Token
underlyingAsset: Ghana state enterprise commodity receipt — mineral ore / agricultural produce stored at certified government warehousing facility
description: Electricity Company of Ghana issues warehouse receipt tokens backed by commodities produced or procured by the enterprise. Token holders receive pro-rata claims on certified stored inventory, enabling smallholder suppliers to access immediate liquidity.
regulatoryFramework: State Enterprises Act; SEC Ghana Digital Asset Guidelines 2023

tokenName: Electricity Company of Ghana Workforce Service Contract Token
underlyingAsset: Ghana public sector service contract — vetted suppliers, maintenance contractors and consultants engaged by Electricity Company of Ghana
description: Electricity Company of Ghana tokenises service contracts with suppliers and independent contractors. Micro-enterprises and artisans can tokenise outstanding invoices as collateral for working-capital loans, eliminating the 90-day government payment delay.
regulatoryFramework: State Enterprises Act; SEC Ghana Digital Asset Guidelines 2023

tokenName: Electricity Company of Ghana Infrastructure PPP Token
underlyingAsset: Public-private partnership project in Ghana — managed by Electricity Company of Ghana with mandatory 60% local employment quota
description: Electricity Company of Ghana issues PPP tokens for capital infrastructure projects. Each token represents fractional participation in project revenue under a concession agreement. Smart contracts automatically enforce local hiring targets before milestone payments are released.
regulatoryFramework: State Enterprises Act; SEC Ghana Digital Asset Guidelines 2023

tokenName: Electricity Company of Ghana Public Real Estate Asset Token
underlyingAsset: Government-owned land and property portfolio managed by Electricity Company of Ghana in Ghana
description: Electricity Company of Ghana tokenises government property assets to unlock dormant balance-sheet value. Citizens can invest from 1 GHS unit and earn rental income proportional to token holdings, converting public assets into inclusive wealth-generation instruments.
regulatoryFramework: State Enterprises Act; SEC Ghana Digital Asset Guidelines 2023

tokenName: Electricity Company of Ghana Verified Labour Proof-of-Work Token
underlyingAsset: Daily economic activity of casual workers, contract staff and micro-vendors contracted by Electricity Company of Ghana
description: Electricity Company of Ghana issues proof-of-work tokens for every verified day of labour performed by casual workers on government contracts. Accumulated tokens build a portable credit score accepted by partner lenders, replacing the collateral requirement for the unbanked workforce.
regulatoryFramework: State Enterprises Act; SEC Ghana Digital Asset Guidelines 2023

tokenName: Electricity Company of Ghana Capital Project Milestone Token
underlyingAsset: Construction and development project milestones verified by independent engineers at Electricity Company of Ghana projects in Ghana
description: Electricity Company of Ghana issues milestone tokens that unlock progress payments only when independent inspectors verify project completion at each gate. This eliminates corruption in public procurement and ensures employment-creating contractors are paid promptly and fairly.
regulatoryFramework: State Enterprises Act; SEC Ghana Digital Asset Guidelines 2023

tokenName: Electricity Company of Ghana Agricultural Offtake Token
underlyingAsset: Smallholder and commercial farm produce procured by Electricity Company of Ghana under government off-take programmes in Ghana
description: Electricity Company of Ghana tokenises forward purchase agreements with smallholder farmers who supply the enterprise. Farmers receive pre-season financing in token form, redeemable at harvest. This removes predatory middlemen and connects subsistence farmers to institutional buyers.
regulatoryFramework: State Enterprises Act; SEC Ghana Digital Asset Guidelines 2023

tokenName: Electricity Company of Ghana SME Supply Chain Participation Token
underlyingAsset: Small and medium enterprise contracts awarded by Electricity Company of Ghana under preferential procurement policies in Ghana
description: Electricity Company of Ghana tokenises the economic value of SME contracts under its preferential procurement programme. Tokens can be listed on the national digital exchange, enabling impact investors to co-fund local businesses while earning competitive returns.
regulatoryFramework: State Enterprises Act; SEC Ghana Digital Asset Guidelines 2023

tokenName: Electricity Company of Ghana SOE Diversified Portfolio ETF Token
underlyingAsset: Diversified exposure to all tokenised assets across Electricity Company of Ghana enterprise operations in Ghana
description: Electricity Company of Ghana launches a basket ETF token spanning all 15 tokenised asset classes within its operations. A single token gives retail investors diversified exposure to infrastructure, commodities, labor, SME supply chains and government bonds from 1 GHS unit.
regulatoryFramework: State Enterprises Act; SEC Ghana Digital Asset Guidelines 2023

tokenName: Electricity Company of Ghana Partial State Equity Token
underlyingAsset: Fractional economic interest in Electricity Company of Ghana — Ghana government retains majority ownership
description: Electricity Company of Ghana issues fractional equity tokens representing an economic interest in enterprise profits. The government retains majority control while citizens, pension funds and diaspora investors access ownership stakes from 1 GHS unit, distributing national resource wealth broadly.
regulatoryFramework: State Enterprises Act; SEC Ghana Digital Asset Guidelines 2023

tokenName: Electricity Company of Ghana SOE Development Bond Token
underlyingAsset: Sovereign-backed development bond issued by Electricity Company of Ghana to finance capital expansion in Ghana
description: Electricity Company of Ghana tokenises government-guaranteed development bonds accessible from 1 GHS unit. Proceeds finance electrification, water, transport or ICT expansion projects. Quarterly coupon payments are streamed directly to token holders' wallets in real time.
regulatoryFramework: State Enterprises Act; SEC Ghana Digital Asset Guidelines 2023

tokenName: Electricity Company of Ghana Universal Access Financial Inclusion Token
underlyingAsset: Financial inclusion initiative of Electricity Company of Ghana targeting unbanked and underserved communities in Ghana
description: Electricity Company of Ghana deploys a universal access token to extend its core services to unbanked rural and peri-urban communities. Women's cooperatives, youth groups and disability enterprises receive preferential allocation at issuance, with minimal KYC via mobile digital identity.
regulatoryFramework: State Enterprises Act; SEC Ghana Digital Asset Guidelines 2023

tokenName: Electricity Company of Ghana Critical Mineral Royalty Token
underlyingAsset: Ghana critical mineral royalties and production-sharing revenue from Electricity Company of Ghana operations
description: Electricity Company of Ghana tokenises the mineral royalty stream from government-owned resource operations. Every citizen holding a royalty token receives a direct share of natural resource revenue, converting extractive industry profits into universal basic wealth distribution.
regulatoryFramework: State Enterprises Act; SEC Ghana Digital Asset Guidelines 2023

tokenName: Electricity Company of Ghana Farmer Verification Proof-of-Work Token
underlyingAsset: Satellite and IoT verified agricultural output records for farmers supplying Electricity Company of Ghana in Ghana
description: Electricity Company of Ghana mints an agriculture proof-of-work token for each independently verified farming event — planting, cultivation and harvest — recorded by satellite and IoT sensors. Verified records build a formal credit identity for smallholder farmers with no prior banking history.
regulatoryFramework: State Enterprises Act; SEC Ghana Digital Asset Guidelines 2023

tokenName: Electricity Company of Ghana End-to-End Supply Chain Track Token
underlyingAsset: Multi-step supply chain provenance trail from production through to delivery — managed by Electricity Company of Ghana in Ghana
description: Electricity Company of Ghana tokenises every custody transfer and logistics event across its supply chain on an immutable ledger. Each step earns employment tokens for transport operators and warehouse workers, creating a traceable, tamper-proof record from source to end consumer.
regulatoryFramework: State Enterprises Act; SEC Ghana Digital Asset Guidelines 2023
